name: demo-dedupe-resume
description: Continuation of the seeded "duplicate claim submissions" build (intake ticket, bug-fix; plan dedupe-1 done; dedupe-2 and dedupe-3 open) after its main-branch decision is answered: branches on "Hold for UAT first" versus "Merge to main", closes dedupe-2 with a diff and commits the fix and its regression test to uat/<ticket> (the AOC-Ticket and AOC-Session trailers, scoped git only) as the evidence for dedupe-3. The build never touches main: the ticket then goes to UAT.

steps.text: Merge approved: finishing the idempotency guard before the merge.
Holding for UAT as decided: finishing the guard on the fix branch.
steps.label: uat

evidence.detail: Retries reuse the first claim id for the same idempotency key

steps.command: git switch -c uat/$AOC_TICKET_ID || git switch uat/$AOC_TICKET_ID

steps.description: Stage the guard and its test

steps.command: git commit -m "Make claim submission idempotent on retry" -m "AOC-Ticket: $AOC_TICKET_ID" -m "AOC-Session: $AOC_SESSION_ID"

evidence.detail: Guard and regression test committed to the UAT branch

steps.description: Leave the shared working copy where it was

steps.text: The retry-dedupe fix is committed to its UAT branch with its regression test.
